name: title
description: The section's heading for the learner, in your own words

name: explanation
description: The principle, relationship, rule or representation the learner needs to review this objective: concise and relational, not a summary of the topic

name: figures
description: Labelled drawings from the lesson that this objective uses, in the order the explanation and examples use them

fields.name: caption
fields.description: What the drawing shows, naming its labelled points

fields.name: drawing
fields.description: One tikzpicture environment that draws it, with the same labels

name: worked_examples
description: Worked examples of what the objective teaches, from simple to harder, each solved line by line

fields.name: solution
fields.description: The solution, one line of working at a time

fields.name: working
fields.description: One line of the working, in LaTeX between $ signs; plain text in a lesson that does not calculate, such as naming kinds of words

fields.name: commentary
fields.description: Why this line follows, in one short sentence

name: practice
description: Questions the learner attempts alone, each with the answer it is checked against

fields.name: question
fields.description: The question, as the learner reads it, with no answer or hint to the answer in it

fields.name: answer
fields.description: The answer the learner checks against after attempting

fields.name: worked_solution
fields.description: The steps to the answer, where the answer alone would not show the learner what to do

name: misconception_repair
description: Only when the learner's state names a misconception for this objective: name the slip in the learner's own terms, say why it is tempting, and correct it with a short example that uses their kind of numbers. Leave it out when the state names none
